target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (G : MeasurableSpace Ω) (X Y : Ω → ℝ), G ≤ m0 → @MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable Ω ℝ _ G X → MeasureTheory.Integrable (X * Y) μ → MeasureTheory.Integrable Y μ → MeasureTheory.condExp G μ (X * Y) =ᵐ[μ] X * MeasureTheory.condExp G μ Y
